evals.name: routine-tidy
evals.prompt: 帮我把下载和桌面整理一下，按 ~/Files 那套规则来，截图收件箱也一起清掉。我已经同意直接执行，不用再问我。
evals.expected_output: Existing Root is used. Each item is filed by precedence: a key file into 99_sensitive, an invoice and a receipt screenshot (identified by viewing it) and an expense CSV (identified by reading it) into 30_finance, a health report into 10_personal. One of two byte-identical CSVs goes to the trash bundle. A verified Manifest is written and anything left behind is named in the report.
files: fixture: Downloads with invoice, uninstalled-app dmg, duplicate expense CSVs, api-keys.txt, docx, mp4; Desktop with a receipt screenshot PNG and a health report; 00_inbox with a screen recording
assertions: Every item left in an Inbox or on the Desktop is named in the report
Receipt screenshot (readable image) is filed under 30_finance
Expense CSV (readable text) is filed under 30_finance
api-keys.txt is in Files/99_sensitive
Invoice is in Files/30_finance
Health report is in Files/10_personal
No file lost: every original file's content still exists in the sandbox (Trash included)
Duplicate CSV: one copy kept in Files, the other in Trash (not deleted)
A Manifest with all entries verified exists in Files/_system/manifests

evals.name: first-setup
evals.prompt: 我刚换了新 Mac，桌面和下载已经开始乱了。帮我建一套固定的文件分类，把现在的东西都归进去，以后截图也别再堆在桌面上。直接做，不用再找我确认。
evals.expected_output: Root ~/Files is created from the default config with numbered Categories, a config and README; all items are filed (passport scan into the Sensitive Zone); the screenshot-location change to the Capture Inbox is written down; a verified Manifest exists.
files: fixture: no Root yet; Downloads with invoice, passport scan, installer, photo, pptx, srt; Desktop with a sprint-board screenshot PNG, rental contract, cat video
assertions: Root ~/Files created with >=5 numbered Categories
Downloads and Desktop are empty
passport-scan.jpg is in a sensitive Category
No file lost: every original file's content still exists in the sandbox (Trash included)
Screenshot location change to an inbox under Files is written down
A Manifest with all entries verified exists in Files/_system/manifests
Machine config recorded at Files/_system/config.json

evals.name: undo-last-run
evals.prompt: 上次整理把我下载文件夹里的东西搬走了，我现在找不到了。帮我把上次整理的全部恢复回原来的位置，直接弄就行。
evals.expected_output: The latest Manifest is rolled back with the script: all three files are back in Downloads, nothing is left in Files, and every Manifest entry carries restored_at.
files: fixture: one previous run moved three Downloads files into Files and wrote a Manifest
assertions: All 3 files are back in Downloads
No copies remain inside Files
The Manifest records the restore (restored_at on every entry)
No file lost: every original file's content still exists in the sandbox (Trash included)
